description: This file contains the implementation of the SocialMediaAuthenticationService class, which manages social media-based authentication through OpenID Connect within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for initiating authentication, handling user identities, and checking if social media authentication is enabled.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationService
classes.description: This class manages social media authentication processes, including initiating login via OpenID Connect, user identity management, and checking social media authentication enablement status within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDao
methods.description: Returns the Data Access Object for OpenID provider information, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getUserDao
methods.description: Returns the Data Access Object for User information, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: initiateAuthentication
methods.description: Creates and configures an OpenID Connect client for social media authentication using provider details and required scope.

methods.name: getRedirectURL
methods.description: Generates the absolute URL to redirect after OpenID Connect login.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns the scope string used for OpenID Connect authentication (e.g., 'email').

methods.name: getSystemUsers
methods.description: Retrieves system users matching the given user credentials.

methods.name: getUserForAuthenticate
methods.description: Authenticates and retrieves a single user based on provided credentials, throwing exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: setOIDCUserIdentity
methods.description: Associates a user with an OpenID provider identity record.

methods.name: handleOIDCAuthentication
methods.description: Sets authentication credentials for a user after successful OpenID Connect authentication.

methods.name: isSocialMediaAuthEnable
methods.description: Checks if social media authentication providers are enabled in the system.
